delivery.title: Lembe mi cwalo piny - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: "Kadhu" kany nyutho kende nia server ma juyenyo udwoko HTTP 2xx status - enyutho ngo nia system ma jucwalo ubedo ka gwoko nyo timo tic ku lead. Nen lembe ma judwoko malu pi gin ma ewacu andha; ka etiye ma oling nyo kende kende, yub eca copo bedu ka nwangu kwac ento ekwero nyo eweko payload i iye (nying kabedo/kit pa API pare marac, kabedo ma mitere i thenge pare ma payload eni uketho i iye ngo, man mukende mapol).

push.title: Outbound Webhooks - Push Leads & Updates
push.intro: Ecopu bedu ni webhook acel acel: JSON , Form (x-www-form-urlencoded), nyo Custom body template peri ku <fieldkey></fieldkey> placeholders (e.g. <example></example> ) - timo tic calu pongu cURL command wang acel.
push.curlLabel: Keth cURL pa CRM pa juruwil peri
push.curlHelp: Med lanyuth pa kwac pa API docs migi nyo Postman miyo iri (ku lembe mandha nyo lanyuth). URL , yore man wi lembe ju goyo gi calu ma gitiye kudu, man key moko ci i iye jugoro piny eno kara ibed ku copo mi yero CRM field ma pongu pi lead acel acel.
